name: Single-view NeRF Training with Depth Map
definition: Initialization of the geometry of visible regions using a 360-degree depth estimation method to train a single-view NeRF, addressing the under-constrained optimization problem of single-view reconstruction.
summary: Single-view NeRF Training with Depth Map reconstructs 3D scenes from one panorama by aligning multiple perspective depth estimates into a canonical map before training, distinguishing itself from methods that apply depth loss directly to raw estimates.
